Create Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h and Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.cpp. Implement a juce::Component subclass named SpectrumOverlay that draws an overlaid pre-drive and post-drive frequency spectrum using a 512-bin (juce::dsp::FFT order 9) Welch-windowed, time-averaged FFT display on a log-frequency / dB axis. Create scripts/validate_plugin.sh, a self-contained release validation script for ShredBoost 1.0.

The script must, in order and with `set -euo pipefail`:
1. Configure and build the project from a clean build directory using CMake (e.g. `cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release` then `cmake --build build --config Release`).

4. Print a final human-readable PASS/FAIL summary and exit non-zero on any failure.

The script must be POSIX/bash and marked conceptually executable (chmod note in a comment). Use the binding product identity: plugin name ShredBoost, bundle com.nspacesystems.shredboost. Do NOT modify anything under JUCE/.

- CMakeLists.txt (to learn the target names, build output layout, and format targets VST3/LV2/Standalone)

Create Resources/Presets/FactoryPresets.xml containing four factory presets for ShredBoost 1.0 and register the presets resource in CMakeLists.txt so it is bundled with the plugin.
